content_text: I just ordered this book and am excited to read it. I love the Team Deakins podcasts; I always learn something new. If anyone here has recommendations for other books, please let me know! I’m a screenwriter, not a cinematographer, so a lot of the technical information goes over my head. Yet I know everything I learn about other departments will make me a better writer so I’d love to hear recommendations.
